deliverables.item: Literature database 2022-2026
deliverables.not_verified: 57 entries: 43 confirmed from search snippets, 12 partially, 2 not found; no full texts accessible (publisher hosts blocked); the specification-named 'DAB digital twin TIM 2025' is IECON 2024 (Bayindir et al.), the Kiel APEC 2025 98 % figure is only a snippet

deliverables.item: Digital twin: observability, RLS/EKF/Bayes estimation, Coss estimator, thermal observer, supervisory
deliverables.not_verified: transition-time sensor is a proposal; no hardware

deliverables.item: FEM_Magnetics: 2-D finite-difference magnetostatics (leakage, proximity, planar vs wound, Pareto)
deliverables.not_verified: 2-D approximation, no 3-D/commercial FEM, no measurement; finds proximity factors 1.41/1.57 vs the design's 1.04/1.08 and a litz packing problem (12.8 mm needed vs 11.7 mm window)

deliverables.item: Parasitic_Extraction: commutation-loop and gate-loop partial inductance from the board geometry, overshoot margin
deliverables.not_verified: closed-form partial inductances, package inductance from literature-typical values, no field solver or measurement

deliverables.item: SiC_Health_Monitoring: Rds_on / Vth drift estimators (RLS, Kalman, CUSUM) on SYNTHETIC degradation data
deliverables.evidence: SiC_Health_Monitoring/results/ (1 % drift detected in 1-7 weeks, 0 false alarms in 3 y with a stable T reference)
deliverables.not_verified: no measured aging data, no RUL claim; needs a V_ds,on sense circuit (proposed) and a <= 1 K life-stable temperature reference

deliverables.item: Active_Gate_Drive: fixed / two-level / Miller-clamp / active-driver trade-off with datasheet models
deliverables.evidence: Active_Gate_Drive/results/ (dv/dt 15-31 V/ns set by I/2Coss under ZVS; active drive not worth it here)
deliverables.not_verified: no switching measurement; -3 V vs -4 V bias discrepancy open (KNOWN_ISSUES #6)

deliverables.item: Reliability_Engineering: FTA (32 basic events, minimal cut sets), FMEDA-lite, exhaustive state-machine check + C conformance harness
deliverables.evidence: Reliability_Engineering/results/ (46 080 transitions checked, 0 mismatches vs dab_control.c)
deliverables.not_verified: failure rates are assumed generic values; no SIL/certification claim; property P1 fails as literally stated (conditional faults by design)

deliverables.item: HIL_Validation: HIL architecture (PROPOSED) + 19 software fault-injection tests
deliverables.not_verified: no HIL hardware; LV-sensor common-cause finding open (KNOWN_ISSUES #10)

deliverables.item: Cybersecurity: IEC 62443 applicability, STRIDE, secure boot/update design, CMAC + replay-counter demo
deliverables.not_verified: C2000 security features marked 'verify vs TRM'; no implementation on the target

deliverables.item: Multiphysics_Models: coupled electro-thermal-aging reduced-order model on an assumed 24 h mission profile
deliverables.evidence: Multiphysics_Models/results/ (lifetime ratios vs forced air: natural 0.01-0.23, liquid 130-5300; slew/fan variants negative results)
deliverables.not_verified: Foster capacitances and lifetime-model coefficients are literature-typical; ratios only, no absolute lifetime

deliverables.item: Adaptive_MPC: PI / CCS-MPC / FCS-MPC / explicit LUT / adaptive RLS / robust tube controllers benchmarked on the switched plant; C2000 WCET budget; wide-range ZVS maps and dead-time table
deliverables.evidence: Adaptive_MPC/results/ (load step: MPC settling <= 0.25 ms vs 2.1 ms PI; reversal and soft start: PI better; only the explicit LUT fits the 10 us ISR; 46 % of the V1 x V2 x P envelope hard-switches at nominal)
deliverables.not_verified: no C code, no toolchain/hardware timing; DPS/TPS not benchmarked as closed-loop inner modulators; scenario windows shortened for runtime; Coss(T) absent from the device table

deliverables.item: Embedded_AI: Q15 explicit-MPC LUT (13.3 KB, 0.9 us) vs Q15 MLP 3-16-16-3 (0.84 KB, 13 us, 1.5 deg rms) - LUT chosen; ISR/10 kHz/1 kHz schedule; bit-exact test vectors (490)
deliverables.not_verified: no C port, no C2000 timing measurement

deliverables.item: Robust_Optimization: NSGA-II (4 objectives incl. damage proxy and ZVS margin), GP-EI search, worst-case and 95 % chance-constrained fronts, knee and baseline position
deliverables.evidence: Robust_Optimization/results/ (baseline within 3 % of the nominal front in loss, dominated in magnetics volume; infeasible under robust/chance variants; strict robust variant empty - closed-form argument)
deliverables.not_verified: SPS only in the loop; assumed distributions and mission profile; literature-typical lifetime coefficients

deliverables.item: Uncertainty_Quantification: MC / LHS / PCE / corner analysis of the baseline, Sobol indices cross-checked (PCE vs Saltelli)
deliverables.evidence: Uncertainty_Quantification/results/ (eta_nom 98.61 +/- 0.05 %; inductance dominates ZVS margins and corner efficiencies; ambient dominates Tj)
deliverables.not_verified: input distributions assumed, no measured tolerance statistics

deliverables.item: Physics_Informed_Models: analytical vs MLP vs hybrid vs PINN vs GP vs LUT vs polynomial surrogates of the DAB map
deliverables.evidence: Physics_Informed_Models/results/ (analytical TPS model 0.12 % vs best learned 0.59 % of range; physics loss did not help)
deliverables.not_verified: lossless ground truth only; learned models would matter only with measured non-ideal data

deliverables.item: Safe_RL_Research: CEM and REINFORCE policies behind a deterministic safety filter and fallback
deliverables.evidence: Safe_RL_Research/results/ (no rms benefit over PI+EPS; peak/V2 limits never reached; 2 model-based ZVS filter misses)
deliverables.not_verified: small search budgets, no deep RL, simulation only; never for deployment without HIL

deliverables.item: Research_Benchmarks: 14-row comparison vs published 6.6 kW-class work, methodology for a fair measured comparison
deliverables.not_verified: our numbers calculated, theirs measured; only confirmed literature entries quoted
